fact: The UN Women and Central Bureau of Statistics assessment (fieldwork March-July 2021, published 2021-12-21) treats Sudan's Statistics Act of 2003 as the current statistics law, calling it outdated and silent on gender statistics.

The 2012 Sudan National Strategy for the Development of Statistics lists among the weaknesses of the national statistical system an inadequate Statistics Act and non-implementation of some of its provisions, so an act exists; the document gives no year for it, so the date is the document's September 2012 publication.
